title: Pilot slice: Local-first nightly batch rebuild
objective: Route a high-capacity Local-first batch workload to the Gigabyte execution lane without manual relabeling.
acceptance_criteria: The issue routes deterministically to the Gigabyte lane.
The lane selection reflects the workload class and throughput posture.
Cloud fallback remains available if the Gigabyte lane is unavailable.

focus: Schema validation succeeds for Gigabyte-capable routing metadata.
Primary execution lane resolves to local-first-gigabyte.
Fallback from Gigabyte to Cloud-first is explicit.
